title: QRY: qry04 cross-tenant test references audit_entries.created_at — column is named timestamp
symptom: Test qry04_cross_tenant_probe_returns_empty_envelope queries audit_entries.created_at but the column is named timestamp (not created_at). sqlstate=42703.
root_cause: Test bug — incorrect column name reference. The audit_entries table has a column named 'timestamp', not 'created_at'.
acceptance_criteria: Test updated to reference audit_entries.timestamp instead of audit_entries.created_at
fix_note: This is a test bug, not an implementation bug. No change to source implementation required.
diagnosis: CONFIRMED (Category D, test bug). DB inspection shows audit_entries has column timestamp not created_at. Full column list: audit_id, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, timestamp, before_state, after_state, tenant_id, pipeline_run_id, chain_hash, prev_chain_hash, payload_full, trace_id. Two tests in query_qry01_04_test.zig use ORDER BY created_at DESC: qry04_cross_tenant_probe_returns_empty_envelope (line 985) and qry01_audit_event_recorded_without_filter_values (line 560). Both must be updated to use timestamp.
